thread:
Tanya: Heads-up: heavy downpour at Embarcadero entrance. puddles big enough to test canoe prototypes. :sweat_drops: anyone delayed?
Omar: stuck under the awning by 1st St. my hoodie is doing its best impression of a wet sponge.
Gabe: bus 10 just passed me like a water cannon. soaking guaranteed. :grimacing:
TransitBot: ⚠️ Service notice: Surface vehicle speeds reduced across Embarcadero due to weather. Expect +10-20 minute delays on bus routes. https://sftransit/alerts/weather-2026
Renee: quick PSA: if you brought non-waterproof shoes, leave them in the drying rack on 1F. labeled bin "wet footwear".
Ivy: is the office handing out umbrellas? my tiny one surrendered immediately.
FacilitiesBot: Supply check: We have 4 spare umbrellas, 2 industrial fans, and 1 box of new socks. Swing by reception.
Tanya: omg FacilitiesBot you rock. grabbing socks now. :sparkles:
Omar: offering umbrella share at 1st & Embarcadero. DM for meetup.
Gabe: bike commuters: watch out for oil slicks near the Market intersection. slipped on a banana peel + puddle combo.
Ivy: anyone taking the ferry from Sausalito later? thinking of switching to ferry to avoid gridlocked buses.
Renee: ferry looks like a solid Plan B. also, free coffee at the lobby for anyone who braved the storm. :coffee:
Tanya: standup tweak: let's do a 10-min delay. audio-only option open.
Omar: meme incoming: "My umbrella after 2 gusts" https://imgur.com/fake-meme-umbrella :joy:
Gabe: cheers to facilities & the free socks. walking in now, socks already in action.
TransitBot: Reminder: avoid standing on wet metal grates during storms. Stay safe.
Ivy: two people offered rides. I took one. ride-sharing FTW. :raised_hands:
Tanya: TL;DR: buses delayed, umbrella/sock rescue in lobby, ferry option, standup delayed 10m. thanks team.
